title: Squarefree polynomial representation on the root cube
statement:
Let $K$ be a field, fix an element $\omega \in K$, and let $n$ be a natural number. Write $\{1,\omega\}^n$ for the set of vectors $x = (x_1,\dots,x_n)$ with each coordinate $x_i \in \{1,\omega\}$. Then for every function $f : \{1,\omega\}^n \to K$ there exist coefficients $c_S \in K$, indexed by the subsets $S \subseteq \{1,\dots,n\}$, such that the squarefree (multilinear) polynomial
\[
  P(X_1,\dots,X_n) \;=\; \sum_{S} c_S \prod_{i \in S} X_i
\]
satisfies $P(x) = f(x)$ for every $x \in \{1,\omega\}^n$.
hypotheses_covered: an arbitrary function $f$ on the root cube $\{1,\omega\}^n$
replaced:
Every function $f : \{1,\omega\}^n \to K$ on the root cube is represented by a squarefree
(multilinear) polynomial: there are coefficients $c$ indexed by finsets of
$\mathrm{Fin}\,n$ such that $(\texttt{ACP.squarefreePolynomial}\ c)(x) = f(x)$ for all
$x$ in the root cube.
